chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abu Yahya al-Wasiti, from Ajlan Abu Salih, who said:

A man entered upon Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) and said to him, 'May I be your ransom, is this the dome of Adam (peace be upon him)?' He (peace be upon him) said, 'Yes, and by Allah, there are many domes. Indeed, behind this West of yours are thirty-nine other Wests, white lands filled with creatures who illuminate themselves with its light. They have not disobeyed Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, for the blink of an eye. They do not know whether Adam was created or not; they distance themselves from So-and-so and So-and-so.'

key_terms.طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ: The blink of an eye (a short moment)
key_terms.قُبَّةُ آدَمَ: The dome of Adam (referring to the sky)

ai.seo_question: What is the cosmological structure of the heavens and other lands according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) confirms the cosmological significance of the 'Dome of Adam' and reveals a vast, multi-layered universe containing thirty-eight additional lands beyond the known world. These pristine realms are inhabited by pure creatures who have never disobeyed God and remain unaware of Adam’s creation, yet they actively disown specific figures, reflecting the Shia theological concept of *al-Bara’* (disavowal) of the early Caliphs.

en.hubeali: H 14749 – From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Abu Yahya Al-Wasity, from Ajlaan Abu Salih who said:

A man came up to Abu Abdullahasws, so he said to himasws, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws. This here (the sky) is the dome of Adamas?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes. By Allahazwj, there are numerous domes. Indeed! Behind this West of yours are thirty-nine (other) in the West, white lands filled with creatures illuminated by its light. They have never disobeyed Allahazwj even for the blink of an eye. These creatures are not aware of the creation of Adamas, but they are distancing themselves (Tabarra) from so and so and so and so (Abu Bakr and Umar)’.
en.sarwar: 301. From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Abu Yahya Al-Wasity, from Ajlaan Abu Salih who said:

A man came up to Abu Abdullah (a.s.), so he said to him (a.s.), ‘May I be sacrificed for you (a.s.). This here (the sky) is the dome of Adam (as)?’ He (a.s.) said: ‘Yes. By Allah (azwj), there are numerous domes. Indeed! Behind this West of yours are thirty-nine (other) in the West, white lands filled with creatures illuminated by its light. They have never disobeyed Allah (azwj) even for the blink of an eye. These creatures are not aware of the creation of Adam (as), but they are distancing themselves (Tabarra) from so and so and so and so (Abu Bakr and Umar)’.
